The '''North Crimson Flats''' were a region on the [[Double Worlds|Twin World]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was located just north of the [[South Crimson Flats]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The North Crimson Flats are one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
